name: PaperPod

modes.label: Native product meter; not a general-purpose 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM
modes.note: Not auto-rankable for generic VM workloads. Native price and usage limits are preserved in provider rate_cards/extras and regimes. Empty sizes intentionally prevents inventing CPU/RAM capacity or treating missing rates as zero.
modes.metering_example: The official example prices 50 runs averaging 400 ms as 20 aggregate seconds and $0.002; the underlying billing-clock precision is still not stated.

plans.name: Pay per request
plans.note: Prepaid via MPP / Tempo / Stripe; no public subscription fee.

free.conditions: New accounts receive $5 once; signup uses an email magic link and requires no credit card. Credit expiry is not published.

caveats: vCPU/RAM, concurrency and session ceilings not published; execution-hour cost is not a 4/8 VM quote.
Compute, process, and browser operations have separate meters; WebSocket usage is billed per operation, not per connection. Exact rounding of overlapping operations remains unpublished.
Sandbox filesystem is ephemeral; Agent Memory is persistent but only 10 MB, not 50 GiB snapshots.
Prepaid 20/100 dollar packs include 10%/20% bonuses; these are credit offers, not permanent unit-rate cuts.
Browser/session lifecycle overhead, billing minimum and exact paused-retention terms not established.
Native billing cannot be reduced to a 4-vCPU/8-GiB price. No matching engine sizes, by design.
Background processes started via the HTTP API auto-terminate after 15 min (use the 'ppod start' CLI for longer).

fleet.verification: Email magic-link authentication documented; no ID/business-document requirement stated.
fleet.notes: Public API descriptor describes per-user container execution and paid requests. No numeric account parallel-container fleet quota or increase process established; simultaneous commands inside a container are not distinct VMs.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: "sandboxFiles": "Ephemeral - lost when session ends. Use /workspace or /tmp paths."
snapshot_auto.note: Only persistence is Agent Memory (10 MB key/file store via /memory/* API, R2-backed) which 'survives session resets'; no machine-state save on session end.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: "agentMemory": "Persistent - survives session resets. 10MB quota. Use /memory/* endpoints."
snapshot_on_demand.note: The root JSON is the complete public endpoint list (execute, files, process, expose, browser, ai, memory, ws); no snapshot/checkpoint/fork endpoint or CLI command.

harness_api.note: PaperPod is the runtime an external agent (Claude Code, OpenClaw, ...) drives via CLI/HTTP; the full endpoint list has only exec/process/file/browser/AI-inference endpoints, no API to start or drive an agent harness inside the sandbox.

egress_allowlist.quote: "networkAccess": "Outbound network works: DNS lookups, git clone, HTTP requests all allowed"
egress_allowlist.note: No egress control parameter on any endpoint. Browser endpoints have provider-side SSRF protection ('Internal/private IPs blocked'), which is not a user-configurable allowlist.

volume_attach.quote: **Sandbox is ephemeral** — use Agent Memory (`/memory/*`) for persistence
volume_attach.note: No mountable volumes; Agent Memory is a 10 MB per-user API store, not a filesystem mount.

volume_shared.quote: **Sandbox is ephemeral** — use Agent Memory (`/memory/*`) for persistence
volume_shared.note: Agent Memory is per-user and readable from any session via API, but it is not a mounted shared filesystem.

isolation.quote: "isolation": "Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment - you can only affect your own ephemeral sandbox"

image_oci.note: not offered: full endpoint list (execute/files/process/expose/browser/ai/memory) has no image/custom-image parameter or registry-pull endpoint; sandboxes run a fixed pre-installed toolset.

docker_inside.quote: 50+ tools (ffmpeg, sqlite, pandoc, imagemagick)... Runtimes: python, node, npm, bun, pip
docker_inside.note: not offered: pre-installed tool list has no docker/podman/containerd; the sandbox is itself a container (shared kernel), so docker-in-docker is not documented or implied.

nested_virt.quote: "isolation": "Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment"
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; container isolation gives no /dev/kvm access, and no such capability is documented.

desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; PaperPod exposes headless Playwright automation (screenshot/pdf/scrape/markdown/content), not a graphical VNC/RDP desktop.

computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; browser endpoints capture/scrape a given URL, there is no screenshot+click driving API for a desktop or browser session.

anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; the only documented browser security feature is provider-side SSRF protection, not stealth/fingerprint evasion against bot detection.

captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; PaperPod is a code-exec/browser-automation sandbox, no CAPTCHA-solving endpoint exists in its API surface.

ssh.quote: endpoints: execute, execute/stream, files/*, process/*, expose, browser/*, ai/*, memory/*, ws/session, ws
ssh.note: not offered: the complete endpoint list has no SSH access; the sandbox is reached only via HTTP/CLI/WebSocket exec calls.

snapshot.quote: "sandboxFiles": "Ephemeral - lost when session ends. Use /workspace or /tmp paths."
snapshot.note: Only persistence is the separate 10MB Agent Memory key/file API; no filesystem or memory snapshot/checkpoint mechanism exists.

fork.quote: endpoints: execute, files/*, process/*, expose, browser/*, ai/*, memory/*, login, topup, balance, ws
fork.note: not offered: no clone/fork endpoint exists in the documented API.

fork_running.quote: endpoints: execute, files/*, process/*, expose, browser/*, ai/*, memory/*, login, topup, balance, ws
fork_running.note: not offered: no fork/clone capability at all, so a running-clone variant does not exist either.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: endpoints: execute, files/*, process/*, expose, browser/*, ai/*, memory/*, login, topup, balance, ws
memory_snapshot_fork.note: not offered: no fork or memory-snapshot capability exists in the API.

pause_resume.quote: endpoints: execute, files/*, process/*, expose, browser/*, ai/*, memory/*, login, topup, balance, ws
pause_resume.note: not offered: no pause/resume/suspend endpoint; sandboxes are ephemeral and billed per-second of active use, not paused.

wake_on_request.note: Pay-per-execution model spins up a container automatically for a request (with optional sessionId reuse); there is no explicit 'start machine' step, consistent with wake-on-request behavior.

auto_stop_idle.quote: "Sandbox is ephemeral" — use Agent Memory (`/memory/*`) for persistence
auto_stop_idle.note: Sandboxes are described as ephemeral/session-based with background processes auto-terminating after 15 minutes, implying idle sandboxes are torn down automatically rather than left running indefinitely.

live_resize.note: not offered: no CPU/RAM sizing or resize parameter appears anywhere in the API; the product has no configurable machine sizes to resize between.

agent_harnesses.quote: Pre-installed Tools (50+): Runtimes (python, node, npm, bun, pip), Version Control (git, gh), ...
agent_harnesses.note: not offered: the pre-installed tool list has no coding-agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) offered as a template.

own_agent_api.quote: POST /ai/generate "Text generation using LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, etc.)"
own_agent_api.note: not offered: the AI endpoints are raw model inference (text/embed/image/transcribe) via Workers AI, not a first-party browsing/computer-use/research task agent that PaperPod itself drives.

mcp_server.quote: "discovery": {"cli": "ppod help", "http": "GET / returns JSON schema, GET /docs returns HTML docs", "skillMd": "GET /SKILL.md or /.well-known/skill.md for Agent Skills format"}
mcp_server.note: not offered: PaperPod documents an Agent Skills file (SKILL.md) for LLM agents to read, but no MCP server package or endpoint is published.

public_ipv4.note: Ports are reached via subdomain preview URLs (paperpod.work), not a per-machine public IPv4 address.

ingress_rules.quote: POST /expose "Expose port and get preview URL" ... "Preview URLs are stable across restarts."
ingress_rules.note: not offered: /expose returns an open preview URL with no documented auth/allowlist/private-URL option to control who can reach it.

egress_http_rules.quote: "networkAccess": "Outbound network works: DNS lookups, git clone, HTTP requests all allowed"
egress_http_rules.note: not offered: no method/path-level egress rule parameter exists on any endpoint; only provider-side browser SSRF protection blocking private IP ranges is documented.

guest_firewall.quote: "isolation": "Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment"
guest_firewall.note: Isolation is container (shared kernel), not a full VM/microVM, so the guest_firewall derivation condition (VM/microVM with root=true) does not apply.

secret_proxy.note: not offered: /execute accepts a plain env object; no documented first-party credential-injection proxy for outbound HTTP calls.

static_egress_ip.quote: "networkAccess": "Outbound network works: DNS lookups, git clone, HTTP requests all allowed"
static_egress_ip.note: not offered: no fixed/static outbound IP feature is documented; sandboxes are ephemeral multi-tenant containers.

gpu.quote: POST /ai/generate "Text generation using LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, etc.)" ... pricing "$0.02/1K neurons"
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; AI inference is a managed 'neurons'-billed model API (Workers AI style), not a raw GPU machine offering.

windows.quote: "environment": {"isolation": "Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment"}
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; the sandbox is explicitly a Linux container environment.

macos.quote: "environment": {"isolation": "Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment"}
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope; only Linux containers are offered.

self_host.note: not offered: PaperPod is offered only as PaperPod's own hosted multi-tenant service (paperpod.dev); no self-hosting package or on-prem deployment is documented.

byoc.note: not offered: no bring-your-own-cloud / dedicated deployment into a customer's own account is documented; it is a single shared SaaS endpoint.

open_source.quote: npm package @paperpod/cli metadata has no repository or homepage field linking to a source repo
open_source.note: Only the CLI is distributed via npm with no linked source repository; the backend/sandbox service itself is not published as open source.

sso.note: The only documented authentication method is email magic-link tokens; no SAML/OIDC SSO option is mentioned.

soc2.quote: description: Isolated agent runtime for code execution, live preview URLs, browser automation, 50+ tools (ffmpeg, sqlite, pandoc, imagemagick), LLM inference, and persistent memory — all via CLI or HTTP, no SDK or API keys required.
soc2.note: not offered: no security/trust/compliance page exists on the site (/security and /trust both 404) and none of the official docs mention SOC 2; this is a single-maintainer, early-stage (npm CLI v0.1.x/2.0.4 skill) pay-per-execution sandbox with no published compliance program.

hipaa.quote: description: Isolated agent runtime for code execution, live preview URLs, browser automation, 50+ tools (ffmpeg, sqlite, pandoc, imagemagick), LLM inference, and persistent memory — all via CLI or HTTP, no SDK or API keys required.
hipaa.note: not offered: no security/compliance page (/security, /trust return 404) and no BAA/HIPAA mention anywhere in the root API descriptor or SKILL.md; a solo-maintained, magic-link-auth, pay-per-second execution sandbox with no compliance program documented.

eu_data_residency.note: not offered: the provider card's own regions list is empty and no official page offers a region/data-residency selector; the root API descriptor and SKILL.md never mention regions or EU hosting.

persistent_disk.quote: "persistence": { "sandboxFiles": "Ephemeral - lost when session ends. Use /workspace or /tmp paths.", "agentMemory": "Persistent - survives session resets. 10MB quota. Use /memory/* endpoints." }
persistent_disk.note: Provider's own root API descriptor explicitly states sandbox files are ephemeral and lost on session end (default, no opt-in to keep them). The only persistent store is Agent Memory, a 10MB key/file API-backed quota (R2-backed), not a mounted disk/volume — same is repeated verbatim in SKILL.md ('Sandbox is ephemeral — use Agent Memory (/memory/*) for persistence'). No pause/resume or snapshot mechanism that preserves the filesystem is offered. Confirms the card's false value with a direct quote.

egress_ip_type.quote: "networkAccess": "Outbound network works: DNS lookups, git clone, HTTP requests all allowed"
egress_ip_type.note: derived: PaperPod is a multi-tenant, ephemeral per-request container sandbox ("Each user gets their own container with a full Linux environment") with no static/residential/mobile egress IP feature documented anywhere in the API schema, docs, or SKILL.md (static_egress_ip is explicitly false). Outbound traffic is described only as generically working; absent any dedicated/residential IP offering, shared datacenter egress is the standard default for this class of pay-per-execution container product.
